media.title: Wonderful
media.creator: Jess Wilson for V&A

observations.observation: An upright complete print has a large white serif WONDERFUL word with dark displaced shadow over curving interlocking bands of pink, aqua, orange, ochre, green and purple. The lower pale margin retains handwritten edition/signature. Multiple colors and relatively clean shapes connect a psychedelic composition to the verified Riso process without making the two aesthetics identical.
